limits.location: All coordinates came from simulated Playwright geolocation fixtures. These are neither personal locations nor physical-phone evidence.
limits.nativeProbe: Read-only native browser geolocation acquisitions with maximumAge 30000 and 0; no source mutation.
limits.productProbe: Fictional local demo account and deterministic fictional route fixture. No trip POST was observed, no contact recipients were selected, and no contact alerts were sent.
limits.providers: No proof of a live route, operating transport, open place, or safety outcome.
limits.credentials: Session cookies and bearer credentials are excluded. Authentication responses are recorded as status codes only.

finding: After a wrong-origin acquisition, changing simulated geolocation did not invalidate the native cached fix. The next confirmation with maximumAge 30000 received the same wrong point and timestamp and correctly failed proximity checks. A native maximumAge 0 acquisition returned the corrected point.
repairStatus: Root subsequently changed explicit requestLocation acquisition to maximumAge 0. This historical probe does not claim verification of the rebuilt application.
